scope: Independent pure scalar source/test review only. No model deserialization, numerical data access, CUDA, process launches or test-source access.
reviewed: Root-bound complete six-job capacity summary, paired initial-state/schedule proof and exact q4/q2/r4/r2 recomputation are required. The scalar tool intentionally consumes the verified summary rather than deserializing checkpoints again.

Both base0/mix0 distinct512 capacity checkpoints require three separate validation timing modes, fixed source-order-grid size cases, fullH295 and all six policies, same-state target7, and128 clean histories.

Each root timing receipt binds exact protocol/status/scalar/NPZ bytes within its output directory, successful stopped/reaped PID/exit/duration, exact complete row coverage and no failed attempt/temporary output. Failed full-rollout prefixes cannot supply a timing estimate.

Full unit cost is the sum of maximum measured complete source cost for each of six policies; diagnostic unit cost is the maximum complete frame cost. Whole-process setup/other duration retains publication and observer overhead.

Evaluation forecast budgets all six final models,30 validation and up to30 future test sources, five same-state frames per source,128 clean validation histories and separate invocation setup. No future test count or geometry is inspected or assumed for source selection.

Training forecast uses endpoint times the sum of4/2-wave q maxima plus each checkpoint-count times full observed residual maxima. Evaluation is serialized with no unmeasured overlap credit; explicit multiplier and reserve remain planning assumptions.
Candidate endpoint list is never selected, launched or promoted. Planning uses the earlier Oct7 01:00UTC compute/analysis deadline and reports slack/fits only under stated assumptions.
Complete terminal binding map includes scalar inputs/release, reviewed evaluator source and every timing artifact. Late mutation clears all forecasts and leaves a retained unavailable reason.
limits: Root must independently review and bind the actual capacity summary and stopped timing receipts; this source review does not prove their future authenticity or completeness.

Observed seed0 probe-state size-case maxima cannot guarantee runtime for final trained states, all seeds or future test geometry. The multiplier is an engineering reserve, not a statistical upper bound.
The worksheet does not use efficacy scalar values for endpoint selection and cannot authorize training. Root must select any endpoint prospectively from timing feasibility before final training/test.
FullH295 timing, final data/checkpoint evidence and all scientific outcomes remain unexecuted by this review.
